scenarios.requirement: Server baseline rank and relative order are preserved by terminal rendering.
Local text filtering may hide rows but preserves server rank and relative order and exposes LOCAL FILTER state.
confirmation=UNAVAILABLE remains explicitly unavailable.
evidence_root_diversity=null remains explicitly unavailable.
source_count and source_role_diversity remain propagation/coverage descriptors only.
scenarios.forbidden: independent source or factual confirmation label

scenarios.requirement: FAILED, DEGRADED, and UNKNOWN aggregate states remain visibly distinct from OK in primary workspace chrome.
UNKNOWN coverage is explicit and is not rendered as healthy or absent evidence.
Per-source transport, freshness, completeness, and schema health remain separate fields.
Episode drill-down requests carry the same selected snapshot_id as the ranked workspace.
Changing selected snapshot invalidates inspector evidence bound to the previous snapshot.
API failure is explicit and does not become an empty or healthy intelligence state.
An empty public view is described as zero rows returned by that view, not observed absence in the world.
Terminal remote transport exposes GET only.
scenarios.forbidden: POST PUT PATCH DELETE or mutation RPC

scenarios.requirement: Lens selection, row navigation, inspector, health, audit, help, filter and refresh have frozen keyboard commands.
Global keyboard commands do not fire while typing in editable controls except safe Escape behavior.
Full snapshot/receipt/version/as_of identity is keyboard-reachable and not hover-only.
Critical health and coverage states have textual state labels in addition to visual styling.
Terminal does not introduce advanced lifecycle, entity, provenance-root, confirmation, confidence, or manipulation labels absent from public response.
A deterministic 500-row fixture preserves semantic order and baseline ranks through terminal view helpers.
scenarios.forbidden: performance shortcut that changes semantic order

scenarios.requirement: Terminal imports generated public-read client/types as remote contract authority.

The EXPERIMENTAL lens renders only clearly-labelled EXPERIMENTAL_SHADOW read surfaces with explicit NO_DATA/UNKNOWN availability and rank deltas against the bound snapshot baseline; entering or leaving it never mutates or replaces baseline lens state.
scenarios.forbidden: unlabelled experimental data, fabricated candidate ranks, or baseline replacement/rerank
